brief: The canvas displays a vibrant, glowing campfire at the center, casting warm orange and yellow light onto the ground. Bright, ephemeral sparks launch from the fire, rising upward in a continuous, randomized drift. As the sparks ascend and dissipate, their trajectory slows and cools, transforming into faint, glowing stellar particles. These particles then drift further apart and connect to form recognizable, glowing constellations that bloom across the dark night sky backdrop, creating the visual effect of cosmic mapping over the heat of the fire.

The visual effect creates a cosmic mapping over the heat of the fire, with particles transitioning through color and behavior as they age. The scene is rendered using batched drawing techniques to maintain performance within the frame budget, with particles forming trails and connecting lines that bloom into constellation patterns across the dark canvas.
